t: A reason given for choosing your words
a: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
p: Wa qul li-ʿibādī yaqūlu-llatī hiya aḥsan, inna-sh-shayṭāna yanzaghu baynahum…
m: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
